name: @jeswr/agent-reference
description: The reference agent runtime of the accountable agent architecture: the pilot's transport-neutral core, mechanisms, stores and the synthetic mortgage scenario, lifted out of @jeswr/personal-agent/pilot. Experimental; synthetic test use only.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/export-schemas.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-traces.mjs && node scripts/run-scenarios.mjs
scripts.lint: biome check src test scripts eval/e0/run.mjs eval/e0/vitest.config.ts
scripts.eval:e0: pnpm --filter '@jeswr/agent-reference^...' build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node eval/e0/run.mjs
